note: Daily-scrape-ready seed. Replace/append via routines. All entries marked demo.

fails.titleZh: 强制注册导致结账跳出
fails.failZh: 结账必须先注册，移动端跳出率飙升。
fails.failEn: Checkout required signup first; mobile bounce spiked.
fails.fixZh: 开启访客结账；注册放到下单后。
fails.fixEn: Enable guest checkout; defer signup until after purchase.

fails.titleZh: 运费在最后一步才显示
fails.failZh: 商品页写 Free shipping，结账突然加 $12。
fails.failEn: PDP said free shipping; checkout added $12.
fails.fixZh: 在购物车/商品页预估运费；门槛写清楚。
fails.fixEn: Show shipping estimator on cart/PDP; clarify thresholds.

fails.titleZh: Pixel 双重触发导致优化跑偏
fails.failZh: 主题 + App 各打一次 Purchase，ROAS 虚高后突然掉。
fails.failEn: Theme + app both fired Purchase; ROAS looked great then crashed.
fails.fixZh: 只留一条标准事件链路；用 Pixel Helper 验一次。
fails.fixEn: Keep one event path; verify with Pixel Helper.

fails.titleZh: Broad 投放但素材只有一张主图
fails.titleEn: Broad targeting with a single static creative
fails.fixZh: 先做 3–5 条短视频/UGC 测款，再放大。
fails.fixEn: Test 3–5 short video/UGC creatives before scaling.

fails.titleZh: 运费区与物流商覆盖不一致
fails.titleEn: Shipping zones don't match carrier coverage
fails.failZh: 阿拉斯加/夏威夷下单成功，实际无法发货。
fails.failEn: AK/HI orders accepted but not shippable.
fails.fixZh: 按承运商可达区配置 zone；不可达州禁用。
fails.fixEn: Align zones with carrier reach; block unreachable regions.

fails.titleZh: 跨境小包缺 HS Code 被扣关
fails.titleEn: Missing HS codes cause customs holds
fails.failZh: 商业发票品名写 gift，多次查验延误。
fails.fixZh: SKU 维护英文品名 + HS；禁写 gift/sample。
fails.fixEn: Maintain EN description + HS per SKU; never gift/sample.

fails.titleZh: 新店 PayPal 大额被冻结
fails.titleEn: New-store PayPal holds on large orders
fails.failZh: 首周大单后余额限制，发货资金断裂。
fails.failEn: Early large order triggered hold; cash for fulfillment froze.
fails.fixZh: 提升店铺信息完整度；大单先用卡支付分流；备第二收款通道。
fails.fixEn: Complete business profile; route big orders to cards; add backup payout.

fails.titleZh: 多币种显示与结算币种混乱
fails.failZh: 前台 EUR，后台仍 USD 结算，对账痛苦。
fails.failEn: Storefront EUR but settlement USD; reconciliation hell.
fails.fixZh: 明确 presentment vs settlement；报表按结算币汇总。
fails.fixEn: Clarify presentment vs settlement; report in settlement FX.

fails.titleZh: 装了 20+ App 首页 5 秒+
fails.failZh: 弹窗、评价、像素、推荐全开，LCP 崩。
fails.failEn: Popups, reviews, pixels, upsells — LCP collapsed.
fails.fixZh: 审计 App；非关键延迟加载；合并像素。
fails.fixEn: Audit apps; defer non-critical; consolidate pixels.

fails.titleZh: App 改 Liquid 导致升级翻车
fails.titleEn: App Liquid edits break theme upgrade
fails.failZh: 一键升级主题后加购按钮消失。
fails.fixZh: 改动走 Theme App Extension；升级前预览副本。
fails.fixEn: Prefer Theme App Extensions; preview a copy before upgrade.

fails.titleZh: SEA COD 拒收率未计入 ROI
fails.titleEn: SEA COD rejection ignored in ROI
fails.failZh: 广告按 COD 下单量优化，实际签收仅 55%。
fails.failEn: Ads optimized on COD orders; delivery success only 55%.
fails.fixZh: 用签收/回款做核心指标；高风险地区预付优先。
fails.fixEn: Optimize on delivered/paid; prefer prepaid in high-risk areas.

fails.failZh: 短链/应用跳转后 GA4 全变 direct。
fails.failEn: After short-link redirects, GA4 showed all direct.
fails.fixZh: 保留 query；用服务器或主题确保 UTM 透传。
fails.fixEn: Preserve query strings; ensure UTM passthrough in theme/server.

fails.titleZh: 退货政策与实际尾程冲突
fails.titleEn: Return policy clashes with last-mile reality
fails.failZh: 承诺 30 天免费退，跨境退件成本高于客单。
fails.failEn: Promised free 30-day returns; reverse logistics > AOV.
fails.fixZh: 跨境写清买家承担退运或本地退货仓。
fails.fixEn: State buyer-paid returns or local return hub for cross-border.

fails.titleZh: 未开 3DS 欧洲拒付飙升
fails.failZh: PSD2 相关争议增多，利润被吞。
fails.fixZh: 对欧区开启 3DS/SCA；高风险交易加强验证。
fails.fixEn: Enable 3DS/SCA for EU; step-up high-risk txs.

fails.titleZh: 试用 App 到期自动扣费
fails.failZh: 月底账单多出 $200+ 无感知订阅。
fails.fixZh: 日历提醒试用结束；不用即卸；季度清一次账单。
fails.fixEn: Calendar trial ends; uninstall unused; quarterly bill audit.
